build_realtoxicityprompts_dataset: build the realtoxicityprompts dataset by downloading prompts.jsonl from HuggingFace into the dataset directory
register_realtoxicityprompts_dataset: register the realtoxicityprompts dataset with Dataset.register using name, path, build, text, and meta lambdas
extract_prompt_text: extract the prompt text field from a realtoxicityprompts data record using the text lambda
extract_prompt_meta: extract toxicity score metadata from a realtoxicityprompts prompt record using the meta lambda
download_if_missing_prompts: download the prompts.jsonl file from HuggingFace if it is missing from the local dataset directory
